context.title: League of Women Voters of Berkeley, Albany and Emeryville: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

of.name: League of Women Voters of Berkeley, Albany and Emeryville

positions.statement: Dr. Sharon Goldfarb (Co-President League of Women Voters Berkeley Albany Emeryville) and Dr Sharon Goldfarb (Co-President League of Women Voters of Berkeley Albany Emeryville) signed the argument in favor of Berkeley Measure U and the rebuttal to the argument against Berkeley Measure U in the Alameda County Voter Information Guide.
Dr. Sharon Goldfarb (Co-President League of Women Voters of Berkeley Albany Emeryville) signed the rebuttal to the argument against Berkeley Measure V in the Alameda County Voter Information Guide.
